honest_take: This is the baseline of modern biking, found on machines meant more for grocery runs than rock gardens. It uses an 8-speed system that works until you look at a steep hill. It is strictly for those who consider "off-road" to be a well-manicured gravel driveway.

honest_take: This 11-speed system is for the hobbyist who wants to conquer mountains but still likes having money for pizza. It is beautiful, expensive, and a great way to experience the unique panic of realizing you forgot to charge your bike before a race.

It’s the ultimate way to prove that while you can’t buy fitness, you can certainly buy the loudest and most glittery way to fail a technical climb.
